learning_units.description: Mastering the 12/16 meter rhythm breakdown (slow, quick, quick, quick, medium)

movement_profile.what_to_avoid: avoid flattening the rhythmic distinctions between the slow, quick, and medium sub-beats.

music_profile.sound_description: The music is defined by a distinctive 12/16 asymmetrical pulse where each measure carries a five-beat breakdown consisting of a long initial beat, three rapid light beats, and a medium concluding beat.
music_profile.tempo_bpm: 120-140 bpm (typical for 12/16 Bulgarian horo; exact tempo range not described in sources)

teaching.formation: Line or open circle (typical of Bulgarian horo, exact hold not described in sources)
teaching.level_notes: Requires strong internal count for asymmetrical 12/16 meter.
teaching.rhythm: 12/16 meter (counted slow, quick, quick, quick, medium)
